notes.title: Escape Haunted Mansion - Early Access - Official release
notes.notes:
[h1]I'm proud to announce the official release of Escape Haunted Mansion![/h1]

Plunge into the terrifying atmosphere of a haunted mansion plunged into darkness, cooperate or kill each other!

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3542310/be4f4dc9bea5001126772e9c73d3db46f88c4c0b/ss_be4f4dc9bea5001126772e9c73d3db46f88c4c0b.600x338.jpg?t=1747296208[/img]

[h2]A quick reminder of how the game works:[/h2]

Haunted” players must complete tasks to win the game and survive!
The “Cursed”, on the other hand, have just one objective: to prevent this escape... at all costs, so don't get noticed.

For added fun, the items you need for your tasks may not be in the same place every game!

[h2]Cool features :[/h2]
Dynamic weather!
Seasonal Halloween scenery (more to come in two future updates).

[h2]The future :[/h2]
- New features.
- Addition of different weather (snow, etc...)
- New locations for items needed for tasks.
- New settings for other seasons (Christmas, Easter, etc.).
- Dynamic random events.
- Possibility for the community to create mods!

[b]Stay tuned for future updates.

Thanks in advance for your feedback, whether it's to improve the game or fix potential bugs![/b]
